heading: Islamic Concept Connections word game
summary: Islamic Concept Connections is a word-grouping game with four intended groups of four terms. Select related words, check the group and read the explanation behind a revealed connection. The boards use cited readings to explain their editorial groupings, while acknowledging that a word can belong to more than one meaningful connection.
steps: Read the board and select four terms you think belong together.
Check the group and use the feedback to revise your selection.
After a group is revealed, read its explanation and cited source reading.

questions.question: What does One away mean?
questions.answer: Three selected terms belong to one of the board's intended groups. You can change the selection and retry as often as you like.

questions.question: Is my different connection necessarily wrong?
questions.answer: A word may have several connections. The game checks this board's intended groups. Read the explanation to understand that choice rather than treating the board as a complete classification of Islamic concepts.
